title: bds-runner.json
description: bc-bds runner options and scalar server-property overrides. The locally generated schema adds the selected server's property documentation and types.

version.description: An exact build such as 1.26.45.1, or "latest".

instance.description: Stable executable directory name under .bds/server. Defaults to the selected version.

instances.description: Named instances and their fixed IPv4 UDP ports. IPv6 uses the following port; pairs must not overlap.

experiments.description: Additional experiment NBT keys enabled on the generated test world.

properties.description: Overrides written into server.properties before every run.
